uncited: The lattice consists of two interpenetrating simple cubic sublattices.
Define the spatial bounding box and a base lattice spacing parameter.
Generate the first sublattice by sampling a simple cubic grid at intervals of `base_spacing`.
Generate the second sublattice by sampling a simple cubic grid at intervals of `base_spacing`, offset by half the spacing along each axis.
Discard any generated points that fall outside the bounding box.
During reconstruction, evaluate a radially symmetric filter at the distance between the query point and each sample point.
